source.repository: external: rust-lang/regex (https://github.com/rust-lang/regex), cloned locally for this review

groundTruth.description: A changelog-only commit ('changelog: update to include #1333'): 10 lines appended to CHANGELOG.md, no code touched. Second known-clean control case in the corpus (after 007), and the first in a different language/repo, specifically chosen because CHANGELOG.md here is unusually large (1823 lines / 73KB accumulated over years), making this also a real test of whether a large irrelevant file causes spurious findings or budget trouble distinct from the code-review question.

runs.label: live run, Claude Code CLI 2.1.299, external repository input, context-window 300000
runs.outcomeNote: All three reviewers completed with zero findings on the changelog-only diff. Matches the known-clean ground truth.

notes: Preflight initially refused BUDGET_EXCEEDED: the included CHANGELOG.md alone is 73KB, pushing input tokens past the default 100k cap even for a 10-line diff. Raised maxInputTokensPerReviewer to 190000 and the CLI --context-window to 300000 (recorded here since --context-window is a run-time flag, not something stored in policy.json). This is a reminder that 'routine, nothing to find' doesn't always mean 'small' - a large unrelated file can still need real budget headroom.
